products.name: MAXVEY "Graffiti Star" Oversized Tee — Jet Black
products.description: The foundational silhouette of the inaugural MAXVEY drop. Cut from ultra-dense 260GSM ringspun combed cotton, featuring the hand-styled red spray-paint MAXVEY graffiti typography, the signature star emblem, and custom illustrated character artwork. Designed with a structured ribbed collar that never sags.
details: 260 GSM heavy combed ringspun cotton
Boxy, relaxed drop-shoulder streetwear fit
High-density screenprint graphic with crack-resistant plastisol inks
Reinforced twin-needle stitching at hem and sleeves
Woven MAXVEY inner collar label & tonal hem tag
Preshrunk fabric to minimize post-wash shrinkage
careInstructions: Machine wash cold (30°C) inside out with like colors
Do not iron directly over the graphic print
Hang dry in shade to preserve deep black pigment
Do not bleach or tumble dry

products.name: MAXVEY "Graffiti Star" Oversized Tee — Canary Yellow
products.tagline: High-Impact Street Palette in Heavyweight Cotton
products.description: Engineered for those who refuse to blend in. Vibrant canary yellow hue paired with high-contrast crimson MAXVEY drip graffiti and star motif. Custom washed for an ultra-soft hand feel without compromising the structured silhouette that defines MAXVEY tailoring.
details: 260 GSM premium combed cotton
Pigment-dyed canary yellow with vibrant colorfastness
Hand-pulled screenprinted crimson graffiti artwork
Chunky 1.25" ribbed crewneck collar
Oversized streetwear drape
Custom woven MAXVEY sizing label
careInstructions: Wash inside out in cold water
Low iron on reverse side of print

products.name: MAXVEY "Graffiti Star" Oversized Tee — Chalk White
products.tagline: Monochrome Canvas with Striking Red Drip Art
products.description: A pristine chalk white silhouette designed to make the red graffiti artwork pop with maximum intensity. Heavyweight yet breathable, engineered specifically to stay comfortable in the Nigerian climate while holding its sharp streetwear form all day.
details: 260 GSM zero-transparency heavy combed cotton
Bright chalk white non-sheer weave
Bold crimson red MAXVEY spray-tag graphic & star icon
Drop-shoulder boxy proportions
Side-seamed construction prevents twisting after washes
careInstructions: Wash with whites only in cold water

products.name: MAXVEY "Cyber Metal" Sleeveless Muscle Tee — Acid Green
products.tagline: Raw-Cut Armholes with Heavy Gothic Metal Chest Print
products.description: Minimalist aggression. Jet black 240GSM cotton sleeveless tee centered with the MAXVEY jagged cyber metal emblem rendered in electric acid green. Features raw-cut distress armholes designed for effortless movement, gym sessions, and layered street style.
details: 240 GSM washed cotton jersey
Raw-edge cut armholes with reinforced stress-point tacking
Vibrant toxic acid green high-density chest typography
Relaxed straight hem with side slits for mobility
Soft enzyme washed for broken-in comfort from day one
